en: Color postcard showing a grand neoclassical university building with a pediment reading "UNIVERSITATEA" and a rooftop socialist-era slogan. People walk along a wide boulevard lined with trees. The reverse has a Romanian handwritten message dated 8.09.1973 from Craiova, a Romanian 40 bani stamp, and a circular transit postmark from Cluj, addressed to Nicolae Mătulescu on bd. Lenin, nr. 37, Cluj.
